text:
maya: Drafting the release notes + micro-timeline for tonight's rollout. Sharing proposed canary/rollback thresholds — need ops + deploybot sanity check. TL;DR: canary 5% for 30m, ramp to 25% for 1h, full at 3h. Automated rollback if error-rate > 1% sustained for 5m or p95 latency > 3x baseline. Also planning an EU hold window.

oli: Ack. Can we pin the runtime image to redwood-rls-v2.14 for hosted and set an explicit fallback to v2.13? Avoids weird drift during canary.

dylan: +1 on explicit fallback. For EU we should hold until 02:00 UTC to avoid the night maintenance window.

deploybot: Scheduled canary job created by @maya — ID: cb-1820009999. Canary start: 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z, target 5% traffic, duration 30m. Health hooks: /health, trace-sampling=yes.

maya: Quick release note blurb draft: "Improved routing heuristics for short-sequence workloads; P95 latency reduced ~12% and token costs trimmed via batching heuristics." Can someone proof?

jen: Tiny nit: "P95" -> use uppercase. Also add a short rollback line: "Auto-rollback triggered if errors >= 1% for 5 consecutive minutes or latency degrades > 3x."

sree: Ops checklist I'm taking: 1) watch traces + error-rate dashboard 2) ensure v2.13 is warm as fallback 3) open CS post if anything user-facing. I'll be on standby during canary.

oli: Also suggest we include the deploy command in the thread for reproducibility:

```
/deploy --env=prod --version=redwood-rls-v2.14 --canary=5% --canary-duration=30m --fallback=redwood-rls-v2.13
```

oli: And set deploybot thresholds: rollback_error_rate=1% rollback_latency_multiplier=3.

maya: Added microtimeline to the RN doc and linked it (internal): https://redwood.internal/rn/1820009999 — pinging @dylan @oli for final signoff before I post the internal announce at canary+10m.

dylan: Signoff for EU hold and thresholds. Go ahead with canary schedule.

deploybot: Canary started (2026-03-25T02:00:00Z) — cb-1820009999. Monitoring hooks active: smoke=ok, cpu=stable, traces=sampled. :rocket:

oli: Saw a small uptick in tokenization errors in staging earlier; watching but not blocking.

jen: If deploybot triggers rollback, run:

```
/deploy --rollback --to-version=redwood-rls-v2.13 --reason="auto-threshold"
```

maya: Thanks — I'll send the internal announce at 02:10 UTC with the RN snippet and the brief ops checklist. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Canary completed (2026-03-25T02:30:00Z). cb-1820009999. Metrics summary: error-rate 0.12%, p95 delta -8%, CPU within expected. No rollback triggered.

dylan: Proceed to ramp to 25% now.

deploybot: Ramp scheduled: 25% at 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z (following cb-1820009999). Will post updates.

maya: Closing thread — will update RN doc with final metrics post-ramp. Thanks everyone for quick checks!"
